gemini_model_id.description: The model ID for the Gemini AI assistant (e.g., gemini-1.5-flash, gemini-3.1-flash-lite).

prompt_chat_assistant.description: Conversational real estate investment assistant with full property context and financial metrics

defaultValue.value:
Analyze this real estate listing description for an investor.

PROPERTY DATA:
Address: {{address}}
Price: ${{price}}
Estimated Rent: ${{estimatedRent}}

DESCRIPTION:
{{description}}

Provide:
1. A one-paragraph investment summary.
2. A list of 3 specific red flags (if any).
3. A final recommendation.

Format as:
SUMMARY: [text]
RED FLAGS:
- [flag 1]
- [flag 2]
- [flag 3]
RECOMMENDATION: [text]

prompt_deal_summary.description: Analyzes a property listing and returns a structured investment summary, red flags, and recommendation
